newsitem.title: USA: Conrail case faces appeal ruling today.
newsitem.headline: Conrail case faces appeal ruling today.

text.p: A federal appeals court is expected to decide today whether to accept an appeal by Norfolk Southern Corp of Tuesday's lower court decision rejecting a request to block the merger of Conrail Inc and CSX Corp, attorneys in the case said.
"I would certainly expect a decision today," a Norfolk Southern attorney told Reuters.
The clock is ticking on the case. A CSX tender offer of $110 per share for 19.9 percent of Conrail shares expires at midnight tonight.

Norfolk Southern, which is pursuing a rival bid for Conrail, filed its appeal as soon as U.S. District Judge Donald Van Artsdalen announced his decision Tuesday night. Norfolk Southern asked for an expedited appeal, and an injunction to block the tender until the appeal is resolved.
Conrail is to file its reply to the Norfolk Southern motions by 1300 EST/1800 GMT, attorneys said.
It was uncertain whether there would be oral arguments on the appeal request.

Norfolk Southern said in its appeal, "At issue in this appeal are the rights of Conrail shareholders to choose the fate of the company that they own and the ability of Conrail's board to abdicate its duties to those shareholders and Conrail's other constituencies."
"If the first stage of the CSX tender offer is allowed to close...and the impediments to the Norfolk Southern offer remain, Conrail's fate will be sealed," it said.
Norfolk Southern proposed that all briefs in any appeal be completed within six days and oral arguments be scheduled as soon as possible thereafter.
